rules.title: Silent or Long-Window Auto-Renewal
rules.fair_baseline: Month-to-month renewal, or annual renewal with <= 15 days notice and an advance reminder.
rules.flaw_trigger: Auto-renews for >= 6 months with a cancellation cutoff > 30 days prior, or no advance reminder.

rules.title: Unilateral Price or Fee Increases
rules.fair_baseline: Price changes require >= 30 days written notice and a penalty-free right to cancel.
rules.flaw_trigger: Provider can raise fees or add charges at any time without advance notice or exit option.

rules.title: Forfeited Prepayments & Early Exit Penalties
rules.fair_baseline: Pro-rata refund if provider terminates without cause; reasonable termination fee capped at actual costs.
rules.flaw_trigger: All fees strictly non-refundable even if provider terminates, or steep early-termination penalty.

rules.title: Asymmetric Liability Cap & Broad Indemnity
rules.fair_baseline: Mutual liability cap at >= 12 months of fees paid; indemnity limited to third-party IP/negligence.
rules.flaw_trigger: Provider caps liability at $0 or <= 1 month of fees while user faces uncapped indemnification.

rules.title: Broad IP Transfer or Perpetual Content License
rules.fair_baseline: User keeps IP rights; provider gets only a limited license needed to operate the service.
rules.flaw_trigger: Perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to exploit user content/work, or IP transfer before payment.

rules.title: Sweeping 'Sole Discretion' Powers
rules.fair_baseline: Suspension, penalties, or term changes tied to objective breaches and prior notice.
rules.flaw_trigger: Provider may suspend accounts, withhold payouts, or alter terms 'in its sole discretion' without notice.

rules.title: Mandatory Arbitration & Distant Venue
rules.fair_baseline: Right to small-claims court or local jurisdiction; class-action rights preserved.
rules.flaw_trigger: Mandatory binding arbitration waiver or exclusive legal venue in a distant jurisdiction.

rules.title: Missing Cancellation Method or Payment Timeline
rules.fair_baseline: Clear self-serve cancellation steps or explicit net payment timeline (e.g., Net-15/Net-30).
rules.flaw_trigger: Document omits how to cancel recurring billing or omits payment deadlines/late-fee protections.
